verdict.rationale: LangGraph exposes a documented programmatic API (Python/JS graph, stream/astream methods) and, via the Agent Server (started through the LangGraph CLI), REST-style endpoints for runs, threads, and assistants, but a live OpenAPI/swagger spec could not be located and community members question how to run this as a production API beyond the local 'langgraph serve'. missing for 10: discoverable OpenAPI/swagger schema, independent confirmation of a stable production REST API beyond local serving.
